about: The special slots (spec docs/specs/combat/spell-slots.md; Lead's reading of Dom: two UNIVERSAL slots, any spell in either). `slots`: one row per slot, `action` is the input verb that casts it, `order` the HUD order. `rules`: numbers. Windup, recovery, cooldown and reach stay the special's own rows (RULES.special): timing is sacred. Costs are the spell's. Nothing reads these rows in a fight yet (the sim PR does).

rules.unit: 1 = a cast from either slot starts the one special cooldown, 0 = each slot its own
1 = the same spell may sit in both slots
